name: Unanticipated timing shift (review item 4.2)
status: frozen before any classifier fit; sha256 of this file is recorded in the run status
question: How much does C3 lose when a shift that the screen did not anticipate also moves features that C3 keeps, and does screening against that shift restore performance?

data.matrix: verified prepared matrix, 119,571 x 70, X_sha256 b852fe0225df0c7b3a3407c3d2c98bccfa2a6252b144f3e2e6d6ba5549df5e6e, y_sha256 e1f328443429dcdfa8c521b1296c72c0c14ad3c17d17543065b4f81c6ab9d15a
data.splits: stratified 70:30, split seeds 0-9, identical to the main experiment
data.models: locked RF, XGBoost and MLP settings (option_b_full_experiment.make_model), model seed 42; RF prediction with n_jobs=1 as in the operator-sensitivity run

operator.base: historical main operator, hybrid768 footprint, applied unchanged (pilot_option_b.make_approx_mlkem)
operator.added: timing operator T_d applied after the base operator to eligible (bidirectional) rows only
operator.delay_grid_meaning: 0 = integrity check; 0.1 ms, 1 ms, 10 ms and 100 ms are assumed handshake delays, not measured values

definition.idea: the handshake adds a delay d to one inter-arrival gap of the flow and to one gap in each direction that has at least two original packets; later packets move d later
definition.Flow IAT Min: + d only when the flow has a single gap (N = 2); otherwise unchanged
definition.Fwd IAT Tot / Bwd IAT Tot: + d when that direction has at least two original packets
definition.Fwd IAT Max / Bwd IAT Max: primary: + d; sensitivity: max(Max, d); same condition
definition.Fwd IAT Min / Bwd IAT Min: + d only when that direction has a single gap (n = 2)
definition.rates (Flow Byts/s, Flow Pkts/s, Fwd Pkt: base-operator value x FD/(FD + d) when FD > 0; when FD = 0, recomputed as base-operator count x 1e6 / d
definition.unchanged: IAT standard deviations, Active and Idle summaries (outside C3 candidacy), and every non-timing column beyond the base operator

conditions.C1: full 70 features, original train and test (fit once per split and model)
conditions.C3u(d): unanticipated: the main C3 model (screen against base(train) only, as in the paper) evaluated on T_d(base(test))
conditions.C3a(d): anticipated: screen against T_d(base(train)), MI >= 0.05 on original training values, refit on the new subset, evaluate on T_d(base(test)); primary variant only

integrity_checks: at d = 0, C1, C2 and C3u weighted F1 equal the locked main values for every split and model (tolerance 1e-12); otherwise stop
at d = 0, the C3a selection equals the locked main selection
T_d leaves ineligible rows and all non-declared columns identical to the base operator output; all values finite
the prepared matrix hash is unchanged at the end

statistics.primary_outcome: C3u(d) - C1 weighted F1, paired over the ten splits
statistics.decision_rule: TOST at +/-0.01 with a 90% paired t interval; Holm across the three models within each delay and variant; equivalent if Holm-adjusted TOST p < 0.05
sensitivity: corrected resampled t (Nadeau and Bengio 2003), n_test/n_train = 35,872/83,699
statistics.secondary: C3a(d) - C1 with the same rule; C2(d) - C1 descriptive; per-class F1 descriptive
statistics.tolerance_summary: largest tested d at which all three models are equivalent to C1 within +/-0.01 (primary variant, recorded procedure); stated as a property of this assumed operator and dataset only
statistics.no_other_tests: no further hypothesis tests will be added after results are seen without being labelled as post hoc

expectations_recorded_before_running: C3u will move away from C1 as d grows, because about ten of the 24 selected features are timing summaries
C3a will flag the changed timing features for d > 0 and should behave like the existing timing-free result
reporting: all delays and both variants are reported, whatever the outcome; results go to Section 5.6 (boundary) and Additional file 1 only after author approval
